mapper.insert: INSERT INTO money_record (record_date, amount, category_id, memo) VALUES (#{recordDate}, #{amount}, #{categoryId}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.record_date, mr.amount, mr.category_id, mr.memo, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, cm.name as category_name FROM money_record mr LEFT JOIN category_master cm ON mr.category_id = cm.id WHERE YEAR(record_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(record_date) = #{month} ORDER BY record_date DESC

SELECT mr.id, mr.record_date, mr.amount, mr.category_id, mr.memo, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, cm.name as category_name FROM money_record mr LEFT JOIN category_master cm ON mr.category_id = cm.id WHERE DATE(record_date) = #{date} ORDER BY record_date DESC

SELECT mr.id, mr.record_date, mr.amount, mr.category_id, mr.memo, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, cm.name as category_name FROM money_record mr LEFT JOIN category_master cm ON mr.category_id = cm.id ORDER BY mr.id
